verdict.description: clean = no P0/P1 defect found in this diff

summary.description: One or two sentences on what the diff does and the overall judgement.

severity.description: P0 = breaks correctness or a documented invariant; P1 = real bug or contract violation; P2 = minor, non-blocking

why.description: Concrete failure scenario: inputs/state -> wrong output. Not a style opinion.
